name: multilo-plugins
description: Multilo's official plugins: skills, commands, agents, hooks and MCP servers.

plugins.name: manuscript-check
plugins.description: Check a manuscript before you submit it: the journal's requirements, and whether citations, references, figures and tables all match up.

plugins.name: peer-review
plugins.description: Write a referee report on someone else's paper: a structured, fair review with major and minor points, and a methods and statistics check.

plugins.name: plain-language
plugins.description: Turn a paper into plain language: a lay summary, a press release, or a short policy brief, accurate and readable by non-specialists.
